assets.name: confirm_panel
assets.description: The panel the leave-the-adventure question sits on, drawn behind the two answers. One picture, so drawn art can change the card's shape, colour and framing — the engine only knows where it goes. Not tappable, so it does not boil. Placeholder via tools/gen_confirm_placeholders.py.

assets.name: confirm_yes
assets.description: The 'yes, leave the adventure' button on the confirmation the back-to-hub button raises. A whole button — background and glyph in one image — and wordless, since the audience cannot read. Belongs to the engine, so every adventure shows the same one. Placeholder via tools/gen_confirm_placeholders.py.

assets.name: confirm_no
assets.description: The 'no, stay here' button on the same confirmation, and the one a stray tap should land on. Placeholder via tools/gen_confirm_placeholders.py.

assets.name: confirm_yes_boil
assets.description: Placeholder boil for the yes button, derived from ui/confirm_yes.png. The boil is what says the button is tappable.

assets.name: confirm_no_boil
assets.description: Placeholder boil for the no button, derived from ui/confirm_no.png. The boil is what says the button is tappable.
